Method of Attack: Unauthenticated site-wide stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability
Privilege escalation via a single HTTP request
Insufficient input sanitization and output escaping on user-supplied attributes
Impacted Systems: WordPress sites using LiteSpeed Cache plugin
Attack Vector: Lack of user input sanitization and escaping output
XSS payload placed as an admin notice displayed on wp-admin endpoints
Authenticated attackers with contributor-level and above permissions injecting arbitrary web scripts
